note: Set A captures the page's key engineering facts that Set B omits: the NEMA 3R junction box on the side of the house, the Sunpreme GX290 module model, and the connection to planter equipment (see E-206), plus the USE-2 10 G.A cable note. Set B does get the frameless glass design and several series-connection polarities right, but it drops the junction-box rating and module model and states the SA2-26 to SA2-27 polarity as positive-to-positive, which contradicts the drawn terminal marks. Set A's clear defects are the U.V. rating misbound to the current-carrying cable (the note assigns it to cable ties) and two claims built on the '11' bonding-jumper symbol treated as a value or connection target. Both sets pad with trivial 'value 3' claims, but A's coverage of the substantive notes and labels is more complete.
